blurb: La Souche is a microbrewery offering a variety of beers including classic, seasonal, and barrel-aged styles made with 100% Quebec ingredients. They operate two pubs with different ambiances in Stoneham and Limoilou, serving food and beer. They also have an online boutique selling branded items like glasses and clothing.
